onboarding.build: Add a sandbox flag so agents can provision a test account without a billing profile.

authentication.build: OAuth client credentials for multi-agent orgs.

blocks: POST /billing/change-plan returns checkout_url that needs a browser

dev_readiness.build: Idempotency-Key header on mutating endpoints; cursor pagination with has_more.
